visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at the entrance of Ueno Zoo. A large crowd of people, mostly wearing casual summer attire, is gathered in front of the main gate which features large grey lettering. A small toddler with pigtails wearing a teal sleeveless top is seen sitting in a stroller. (2) A close-up shows a brown bird with speckled feathers behind a wire mesh fence. The toddler is then seen in her stroller holding a small white slip of paper, her expression curious. (3) The toddler walks independently on a paved path surrounded by green bushes. She looks around as she moves. (4) A tiger is visible within a rocky enclosure with trees in the background, walking away from the camera. (5) The toddler stands next to an adult female (wearing a hat) in front of the tiger enclosure, looking at the animal. (6) A gibbon with light facial fur is hanging and moving along a metal beam structure under a wooden-slat roof. (7) The toddler poses in front of a stone-like wall featuring a relief carving of two gorillas, spreading her arms wide to mimic their pose. (8) On the path, the toddler looks at leaves on the ground. Behind her, another young girl in a red top is asleep in a green-canopied stroller. (9) A large brown bear is in a pool of water, interacting with an orange pumpkin-like ball. The toddler is seen watching from behind glass. (10) Two children, including the main toddler, stand at a glass window watching small otters on a rocky ledge. The otters are eating small pieces of food. (11) Close-up of the toddler eating a slice of apple while standing outdoors. Her hair is slightly damp with sweat, and her expression is serious as she chews. (12) A small monkey with a white beard is seen behind a wire fence, clutching a green leafy branch. (13) The older sister in the stroller, now awake, holds a paper fan and talks toward the camera. (14) A tall giraffe walks within a fenced enclosure with tall city buildings visible in the far background. (15) The toddler looks up at the giraffe, still eating her apple, with a wide-eyed expression. (16) The video ends with a pink screen featuring a cartoon illustration of a girl and text overlays.
